name: openflash
description: Installs LineageOS and other alternative Android systems onto a phone from a browser, over WebUSB. Detects the handset and generates the procedure for that exact device. Note: WebUSB needs a secure context. Served over plain http at a LAN address there is no navigator.usb at all, so the container cannot reach a device — open it at http://localhost:PORT on the machine holding the USB cable, or put a TLS terminator in front of it. This fails silently rather than loudly: the page loads and simply offers no device. Without WebUSB the page is still a correct, ordered, device-specific adb and fastboot command list, which is most of its value.
